title: Chapter 426
text:
This celebrity had a large number of fans in the few Star Clusters in the Shattered Star Ring. He was a singer, and due to the power of the media, his influence was not limited by physical distance.

This performance was to celebrate the New Phylen Alliance's traditional festival of reunification. This was a tradition every year, and this singer was the most popular one among the invited members.

The venue of the performance was a holiday spaceship called Wine and Celebration. Those who could watch the performance were all nobles and wealthy merchants of the New Phylen Alliance. If he wanted to get in touch with the target, he would have to go to the venue. Then, the problem was … how would he get the tickets?

"You want to go to the Unification Day Celebration?"

After knowing the destination of the spaceship, Sylvia rolled her eyes and said, "Stop dreaming. The people who can watch the performance every year are all big shots of New Phylen, political leaders, military leaders, senior officials, and merchants who contribute astronomical amounts of tax every year. With so many big shots gathered together, the security is extremely tight. Don't even think about sneaking in. You might be mistaken for an assassination attempt."

Han Xiao glanced at her and said, "Have you finished memorizing the book I gave you last time?"

Hearing that, Sylvia's aura instantly weakened. She mumbled, "Isn't there still one more day before the test …"

"By the way, you're a citizen of New Phylen. Don't you want to go and take a look?"

"Who doesn't want to go to the celebration? But ordinary people like us can only watch it on TV. "

Sylvia curled her lips, and there was a hint of yearning in her tone.

Unification Day was to commemorate the day when the various countries of the New Phylen Alliance were reunited after the division. It had a huge meaning to the people of New Phylen. It was similar to National Day in Han Xiao's previous life. Sylvia wanted to go every year. Originally, with Langley's official position, he had the right to bring her into the venue. However, Langley was a traitor and a spy.

Now that she had become a mercenary, she no longer had the chance to enter the celebration, so she could only bury this little dream.

Mercenaries were powerful, but their social status was not high. After all, most galactic residents lived a peaceful life. Only when they encountered trouble that needed to be solved by force would they think of experts to deal with such matters. Naturally, they were not willing to deal with dangerous mercenaries. Furthermore, most of the mercenaries were free galactic people with no nationality. Although Han Xiao had worked with the New Phylen Alliance before, the most he could do was request to see the prisoner. He was not qualified to participate in the celebration.

Of course, nothing was absolute. With Floating Dragon's background, if Han Xiao could pull Ames over, he did not believe that the New Phylen Alliance would dare not invite the Dragon Emperor in. Not only that, she would definitely be given a first-class VIP seat, on the same level as the leader of the alliance.

What? You don't want to give face to the Dragon Emperor?

Have you ever seen a brick the size of a planet?

Therefore, it was really comfortable to have strength. When one's strength reached a certain level, there was no need to make a move. It was enough to show off.

Han Xiao touched his chin and muttered, "Since you want to go to the scene, I'll take you with me. It's just a matter of convenience."

Sylvia was stunned and asked suspiciously, "Do you really have the tickets? Impossible … "

"I don't need a ticket." Han Xiao waved his hand. "Someone will invite me in."

"I don't believe you."

Sylvia obviously did not have much confidence. She paused and said, "Plus, I still have to memorize books …"

"Alright, alright, I'll give you a day off."

Han Xiao laughed and shook his head. There was a path to heaven, but you refused to take it.

Herlous came over and said expressionlessly, "Let me guess, do I have to stay and watch the ship?"

"Wow, my brother, we're really getting more and more in sync."

Han Xiao clapped exaggeratedly, and Herlous had a helpless expression.

…

Wine and Celebration was parked at the dock of the main planet of New Phylen. This was a huge spaceship that was relatively flat in the shape of a hexagon. Countless frigates surrounded it. For the Unification Day celebration, this dock was closed for the day and used to welcome all the guests.

In the main hall of the dock, a huge crowd was gathered there. These were all New Phylen citizens who had come to watch the boarding ceremony.

All the performers and political leaders would board the ship through a passage in the dock. This was a ceremony that signaled the start of the Unification Day celebration. It was also the only chance for normal citizens to get close to the scene, so there were many people, and it was extremely crowded.

At this time, Han Xiao was in the crowd. The crowd moved around him, but he did not move. Sylvia grabbed onto his clothes tightly to prevent herself from being pushed away.

At the edge of the crowd were rows of soldiers to maintain order, preventing anyone from rushing to the boarding road. The soldiers on this road frequently looked at Han Xiao with warning and caution in their eyes. Clearly, they could see that Han Xiao was a Super who posed an extremely high threat.

"Black Star … I want to ask you one last time …"

Sylvia's voice trembled, and she kept swallowing her saliva. "We're really not going to cause a commotion and rush to the spaceship, right? Although I've given you the next ten years, don't let me die so quickly …"

Han Xiao was too lazy to answer and waited silently.

After a while, the crowd in the distance started to riot. The important figures finally started to board the ship under the accompaniment of the guards. The crowd let out deafening cheers. These important figures had kind smiles on their faces and waved to the crowd as they walked. Han Xiao had a feeling that they would say, "Thank you for your hard work, comrades."

"They're starting to board the ship … Wow, that's the Alliance's Chairman. I used to see him on TV a lot."

Sylvia did not have time to scold him. She quickly stretched her neck and let out a series of exclamations.

She did not believe that Han Xiao would be able to enter the scene from the very beginning. Now that they had started to board the ship, and Han Xiao was still there, it meant that he was not one of the people boarding the ship. However, Sylvia did not expose him. She was already very satisfied to be able to watch the boarding ceremony. In the past, her father did not allow her to come, so this was the first time she had seen the Unification Day celebration spaceship up close. Even if she could not board, she was still quite happy.

Although Langley was a rebel, he taught his daughter, Sylvia, to love her country very much.

One by one, the people walked over. Suddenly, an even louder voice came from afar, surging like waves. Han Xiao looked up and saw a group of assistants escorting a humanoid creature with a light veil walking over slowly. The masked person revealed a pair of eyes with black eyeshadow, exuding a flirtatious aura. Even the solemn blue robe could not hide the charm he exuded.

"Chen Xing! Chen Xing! "

The cheers were like a tsunami.

Han Xiao nodded silently. This was the person who had triggered the mission, the singer whose stage name was "Chen Xing". Hearing the ear-shattering cheers, one could tell how successful this person's career was.

By the way, this person was a male.

When passing by the section of the road where Han Xiao was, Chen Xing suddenly stopped and slowly turned his head. His gaze pierced through the crowd and accurately locked onto Han Xiao. The next moment, he walked over directly.

The crowd immediately boiled over, wanting to rush up and touch their idol. The soldiers held back the crowd tightly, almost causing a stampede. They gritted their teeth and said, "Your Excellency Chen Xing, please don't come near. It's not safe here."

"It's okay. No one will hurt me."

Chen Xing spoke. His voice was gentle, extremely pleasant, and as pure as water. Those who heard it all felt their hearts calm down. The commotion in the crowd magically stopped, and he walked into the crowd.

The crowd spontaneously opened up a path.

Finally, Chen Xing stopped in front of Han Xiao. Under the gazes of everyone, he smiled lightly and said, "Hello, I hope to have the honor of inviting you to personally watch my performance."

(The chapter count made me a little flustered, so I wrote an extra chapter. There's more to come.)
